groups.directions: In these questions, relationship between different elements is shown in the statements. The statements are followed by conclusions. Study the conclusions based on the given statements and select the appropriate answer.

questions.text:
Statements: P ≥ Q = R > S > T
Conclusions:
I. P > S
II. Q > T

options.label: C
options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow

options.label: D
options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.explanation: From the statements, P ≥ Q = R > S. Comparing P and S, we get P > S. Thus, Conclusion I follows.

questions.text:
Statements: A < B ≤ C = D, E ≥ D
Conclusions:
I. A < E
II. C ≤ E

options.label: C
options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow

options.label: D
options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.explanation: Combining the statements: A < B ≤ C = D ≤ E.

questions.text:

Conclusions:

options.label: C
options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow

options.label: D
options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.explanation: Combining the statements: M ≥ N = O < P < Q.

questions.text:
Statements: W = X ≥ Y > Z, Y ≤ A < B
Conclusions:
I. W > Z
II. X ≥ A

options.label: C
options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow

options.label: D
options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.explanation: For Conclusion I: W = X ≥ Y > Z → W > Z. Thus, Conclusion I follows.

questions.text:
Statements: G > H ≤ I = J < K
Conclusions:
I. G > I
II. H < K

options.label: C
options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow

options.label: D
options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.explanation: For Conclusion I: G > H ≤ I. The opposite signs (> and ≤) between G and I mean no direct relation can be established. Thus, Conclusion I does not follow.

groups.directions: In these questions, the statements are separated by commas. Combine the statements logically to evaluate the conclusions.

questions.explanation: Combined chain for A and D: A > B ≥ C = D → A > D. Thus, Conclusion I follows.

Conclusions:
I. V > S
II. U ≥ Q
III. P < U

options.label: C
options.text: All I, II, and III follow

questions.explanation: Combined chain for V and S: V = T > R ≥ S → V > S. (Conclusion I is True).

questions.text:

Conclusions:
I. G > C
II. F > B
III. A < E

options.label: D
options.text: All I, II, and III follow

questions.explanation: Combined chain for G and C: G = E ≥ D = C → G ≥ C. Conclusion I states G > C, which lacks the '=' possibility, so it is false.
